name: pdf-upload-url
description: Returns a presigned S3 PUT URL for uploading filled PDFs

scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r index.js staff-auth.js node_modules dist && cd dist && zip -q -r function.zip index.js staff-auth.js node_modules
scripts.deploy: npm run package && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name pdf-upload-url --zip-file fileb://dist/function.zip
